title: eval-harness: add per-prompt quality gating CI hook + metrics integration
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Adds a per-prompt quality gating CI hook that runs eval-harness prompt sets and uploads per-prompt metrics to CI artifacts; enables fail/allow lists and soft-fail thresholds configurable per repo.
body:
Context: We've seen several production regressions caused by changes to model shims and prompt templates that didn't trigger existing aggregate eval checks. This PR introduces a per-prompt quality-gating CI hook plus an integration that publishes per-prompt metrics to the CI pipeline so engineers can see which prompts regressed. Motivation: surface prompt-level regressions earlier, allow configurable soft-fails for noisy prompts, and provide richer metrics for triage (accuracy, exact_match, token_overgenerate). Summary of changes: - New CI hook script: tools/ci/hooks/eval_per_prompt_hook.py (runs eval-harness for the changed model/prompt set, computes per-prompt metrics, and posts a compact JSON artifact) - Metrics uploader: tools/ci/upload_eval_metrics.sh (uploads artifacts to CI and posts summary to PR) - Eval harness changes: eval-harness/runner/per_prompt_reporter.py (formatter and thresholding logic), eval-harness/config/prompt_quality.yaml (default thresholds and allow/deny lists) - GitHub Action: .github/workflows/eval-per-prompt-ci.yml (invokes hook on push/PR for changed prompt sets and when the eval-harness tests run) - Tests: tests/eval/ci_hook_test.py and added fixtures for sample prompt sets Checklist:
- [x] Add per-prompt reporter and thresholding logic
- [x] CI hook + uploader scripts
- [x] GH Action workflow for PRs and main branch runs
- [x] Unit tests and integration smoke test in CI
- [x] Docs: docs/eval/per-prompt-ci.md (usage and config) Commits (high-level): - 9 commits: initial per-prompt reporter impl; add config and default thresholds; CI hook + uploader scripts; GH Action workflow; tests + fixtures; docs; fix race in uploader; test flake fixes; final cleanup Files changed (high level): - eval-harness/runner/per_prompt_reporter.py (new) - eval-harness/config/prompt_quality.yaml (new) - tools/ci/hooks/eval_per_prompt_hook.py (new) - tools/ci/upload_eval_metrics.sh (new) - .github/workflows/eval-per-prompt-ci.yml (new) - tests/eval/ci_hook_test.py (new) - docs/eval/per-prompt-ci.md (new) Small illustrative snippets included in PR: - per_prompt_reporter.py: added a compact diff showing threshold check: if metric_value < thresholds[prompt_id]: mark "fail" else "pass" - eval_per_prompt_hook.py: shows how changed prompt sets are detected by running git diff --name-only $GIT_BASE...$GIT_HEAD and filtering under prompts/ Review conversation (chronological): - Lucas Chen (reviewer): "Nice direction. A couple of concerns: 1) uploader uses curl with retries but no circuit-breaking if CI artifact store is down; 2) thresholds in prompt_quality.yaml are pretty aggressive for the handwriting prompt set. Can we make those repo-overridable?" - Ava Martinez (author): "Thanks – both addressed. Added exponential backoff + circuit-breaker (uploads will mark soft-fail if artifact store consistently fails) and moved thresholds to eval-harness/config/.repo_overrides.yaml; GH Action looks for repo overrides first." - Priya Rao (reviewer): "Tests look good; I'm worried about CI runtime – running full eval for large prompt sets could blow PR runtimes. Can we add sampling or incremental runs?" - Ava Martinez: "Good call – by default the GH Action runs sampled runs for PRs (sample_size configurable) and full runs on main/nightly. Documented in docs/eval/per-prompt-ci.md." - Diego Fernández (reviewer): "Left one nit on logging level and suggested a small refactor to the reporter for readability." - Ava Martinez: "Addressed nits and refactor; moved logging to structured JSON lines for easier ingestion." CI timeline / checks: - First CI run (on initial push): failed because tests hit a flaky fixture in tests/eval/ci_hook_test.py (timeout on integration smoke). - Author pushed test fix and added retry in test harness; reran CI. - Second CI run: lint (flake8) passed, unit tests passed, integration smoke ran with sampled set and passed. - Metrics artifact posted to CI artifacts; PR comment automated summary included a small table of 3 prompts flagged as regressions with exact_match drops. - Final CI status: passing Merge outcome: - Squashed and merged to main. Merge commit message: "eval-harness: per-prompt quality gating CI hook + metrics integration – squash" Post-merge notes: - Ops to enable repo-specific overrides in monorepo root documented; team to monitor first-nightly run for noisy prompts and tune thresholds. Testing instructions included in docs/eval/per-prompt-ci.md and in the GH Action description.

Ava Martinez: Refactor + structured JSONL logging added.

ci_artifacts_summary: Uploaded per_prompt_metrics_2025-11-18.json (contains per-prompt accuracy/exact_match/token_overgen and threshold flags). PR comment includes table of top regressions.
notes: This PR is part of a broader effort (ENG-2143) to reduce production prompt regressions. Teams should watch the nightly run to tune noisy prompts. The default thresholds are conservative but can be overridden per-repo.
